title: Digital Communications and Marketing Officer
company: CAV Ice Protection Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
At CAV, it s our vision to place CAV technology on every possible aircraft. We design, test, analyse and manufacture technology solutions for ice protection and drag reduction in the aviation and aerospace sectors.

Since 1942, we have delivered exceptional aviation solutions for light aircraft to commercial airliners and developed a reputation for innovation and excellence.

We re now looking for a part-time Digital Communications and Marketing Officer to join our growing team based in Consett, County Durham.

The primary purpose of the role is to support the Marketing Manager in the planning, creation and delivery of engaging marketing and communication activities across multiple channels, helping to deliver targeted campaigns to maximise brand awareness, generate leads, strengthen stakeholder engagement and achieve Business Development and Sales objectives.

The Digital Communication and Marketing Officer's responsibilities will include:
- Assist with planning, creating and execution marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
- Creating engaging content for the CAV website, social media platforms, case studies, brochures, presentations and promotional materials.
- Creating, scheduling and monitoring engaging content across our social media platforms
- Supporting the development and delivery of email marketing campaigns, promotional activities and targeted marketing initiatives, promoting lead generation activities to drive enquiries and sales opportunities.
- Creating, editing and uploading website articles, blogs, product information and other digital content. Supporting SEO and keyword optimisation activities.
- Ensuring all marketing communications are professional, accurate and aligned with our brand identity.
- Producing engaging copy for newsletters, social posts, marketing materials and internal communications.
- Monitoring campaign activity, social media engagement and website performance to help measure effectiveness.
- Maintain marketing asset libraries, photography, videos, and promotional materials.

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate the following:
- Experience of content creation and social media account population
- Strong understanding of audience segmentation and targeted marketing
- Excellent communication and copywriting skills
- Working knowledge of CANVA and Adobe Creative Cloud
- Working knowledge of email marketing platforms such as Mailchimp
- Familiarity with Wix or similar website content management systems
- Familiarity with Google Analytics and social media analytics tools
- Previous use of CRM would be preferable

The working hours are 24 hours per week.

If you are driven by a job well done and you think you have what we re looking for, we d love to hear from you.

At CAV we value diversity and an inclusive work culture. We are committed to equality of opportunity and avoiding discrimination in any form.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Wolviston Management Services are proud to be recruiting on behalf of Tioxide Materials Ltd for an experienced and commercially focused Marketing Manager.

About the Role
This is a strategic marketing position where you will play a key role in supporting business growth, customer retention, and market positioning.
Working within the Commercial Operations team, based in Stockton, you will partner closely with Sales, Technical, Product and senior stakeholders to provide insight-led marketing strategies that influence decision-making and drive performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver marketing strategies aligned to business objectives
- Provide market intelligence, competitor analysis, and customer insights
- Identify market trends, opportunities, and evolving customer needs
- Support customer segmentation, value propositions, and route-to-market strategies
- Work collaboratively with Sales, Technical Service and Product teams
- Analyse market and sales data to support growth and margin improvement
- Support product development, new applications, and market entry strategies
- Contribute to pricing, product mix, and commercial planning
- Create high-quality reports, presentations, and business cases
- Guide externally delivered campaigns and promotional activity
- Manage relationships with external marketing agencies
- Monitor performance and continuously improve marketing effectiveness

About You
You will be a strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness and the ability to turn complex data into actionable insight.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Experience in strategic, product, or commercial marketing
- Degree in Marketing, Business or related discipline, or CIM qualification
- Experience within a B2 B, manufacturing, industrial or technical environment
- Strong understanding of segmentation, positioning, and value propositions
- Proven ability to use market intelligence and customer data to support decisions
- Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
- Commercially driven with a focus on growth, margin, and customer retention
- Strong organisational and project management skills

Desirable
- Experience in chemical, coatings, plastics, or process industries
- Exposure to international markets or distributor networks
- Product or technical marketing background
- Experience using CRM or business intelligence tools
- CIM Chartered Marketer status (or working towards)

Why Apply?
This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-established and technically focused organisation where marketing plays a key role in shaping commercial strategy.
You will have the opportunity to influence senior decision-making and contribute directly to business growth.

title: Communications and Engagement Coordinator
description:
Communications & Engagement Coordinator

Northumberland Competitive Salary + Bonus + Excellent Benefits

We're working with a highly respected organisation that delivers regeneration, economic growth, housing, commercial development and community-focused projects across the North East. Due to continued growth, they are looking to appoint a Communications & Engagement Coordinator to join their marketing and communications team.

This is a varied role where you'll support both internal and external communications activity, helping to promote major projects, business achievements and community initiatives across a diverse portfolio.

Key Responsibilities
- Create engaging content for websites, newsletters, press releases and marketing campaigns.
- Support internal communications and colleague engagement initiatives.
- Assist with media enquiries and build relationships with journalists and external stakeholders.
- Support events, launches and stakeholder engagement activities.
- Help develop communications plans for regeneration, housing, commercial and community projects.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide insights and recommendations.
- Work closely with senior leaders and colleagues across the business to identify and promote positive stories.

About You
- Degree, HND or equivalent experience in Communications, Marketing, PR, Journalism or a related discipline.
- Experience within a communications, marketing or PR role.
- Strong copywriting and content creation skills.
- Experience managing website content.
- Excellent organisational and project management skills.
- Confident communicating with a range of stakeholders.
- Knowledge of media relations and stakeholder engagement would be advantageous.
- Experience within property, housing, regeneration, local government or the public sector would be beneficial but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary with performance-related bonus scheme.
- Up to 31 days annual leave.
- 8% employer pension contribution.
- Private healthcare and healthcare cash plan.
- Discounted gym membership.
- Employee assistance programme.
- Enhanced occupational sick pay.
- Flexible, supportive working environment.
- Opportunity to work on high-profile projects that make a genuine impact across the region.

This is an excellent opportunity for a communications professional looking to join a purpose-led organisation and play a key role in promoting projects that support economic growth, regeneration and thriving communities across the North East.

title: Senior Client Marketing Manager
description:
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing B2 B marketing agency based in Northumberland working with regional, national and international clients across sectors including engineering, manufacturing, technology, renewables and life sciences. The business delivers integrated marketing services including PR, digital marketing, content, design, SEO and website development, helping innovative organisations grow their visibility and market presence.

The Senior Client Marketing Manager will look after a portfolio of client accounts, building strong relationships and helping to grow existing business. The role involves developing marketing plans, overseeing campaigns, and working closely with clients to ensure activity delivers against their objectives and supports long-term growth.

Job Responsibilities:
- Managing and developing a portfolio of client accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders.
- Acting as the main point of contact for clients, providing strategic marketing advice and ensuring a high level of service.
- Creating marketing strategies and campaign plans that support client objectives and deliver results.
- Working with internal teams across content, PR, digital, design and web to deliver integrated marketing campaigns.
- Identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts and supporting business development activities.
- Ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to a high standard.
- Driving client retention through proactive account management and consistent value delivery.
- Keeping campaigns and marketing initiatives on track, ensuring agreed actions are completed and objectives are achieved.

Job Requirements:
- Experience managing and growing B2 B client accounts, ideally within an agency environment or across multiple businesses and brands as part of a wider group.
- A strong marketing background with experience developing marketing strategies and integrated campaigns that deliver results.
- The ability to understand client objectives and turn them into effective marketing plans and campaigns.
- Experience managing multiple projects and working with a range of internal teams to deliver successful outcomes.
- A track record of identifying opportunities to grow client accounts and increase revenue.
- Excellent relationship-building, communication and presentation skills.
- Strong commercial awareness and the ability to balance client needs with business objectives.
- A proactive, organised approach and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- A genuine interest in working with innovative businesses across technical and specialist sectors.

title: Marketing Executive (Content & PR)
company: Ernest Gordon Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Executive (Content & PR)

£27,000 - £29,000 + Company Benefits + Company Bonus + Progression + 5% Pension and 34 days holiday after 1 year

Newcastle-Under-Lyme - Office based

Are you a Marketing Executive with content writing experience and a full UK driving licence, looking to join an established UK manufacturer offering creative freedom, varied marketing projects and career progression?

This established UK manufacturer designs, manufactures, installs and services pumping equipment for the construction, utilities, housing and wastewater sectors. Supplying reliable pumping solutions to customers nationwide.

In this role, you will support the wider marketing strategy, creating engaging content across press releases, social media, case studies, e-shots, advertising materials and company literature. You will liaise with national press and media, research markets and competitors, coordinate content schedules and support exhibitions and wider marketing initiatives.

This role would suit a Marketing Executive or similar, looking to develop their career across content creation, PR and communications within an established manufacturer.

The Role:
- Create content for press releases, social media, case studies and e-shots
- Write and proofread marketing materials and company literature
- Manage content planners, media schedules and press communications
- Research markets, products and competitors
- Coordinate advertising and support exhibition planning
- Create marketing content using InDesign and Adobe Acrobat
- Work with internal teams to support marketing campaigns across the business

The Person:
- Marketing executive or simialr
- Confident using InDesign, Adobe Acrobat or similar
- Commutable to Newcastle-Under-Lyme

Reference: BBBH27959

Marketing, Executive, Content, PR, Public Relations, Copywriting, Content Creation, Social Media, SEO, Press Releases, Case Studies, InDesign, Adobe Acrobat, Woore, Crewe, Stoke, Market Drayton, Cheshire

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitable candidates. The salary advertised is a guideline for this position. The offered remuneration will be dependent on the extent of your experience, qualifications, and skill set.

title: Account Manager (Marketing Agency)
description:
The best client relationships are built on more than delivering a brief. They're built on understanding what a client needs, bringing the right people together and producing work that makes a difference. As an Account Manager, you'll be the person making that happen.
You'll work with well-known brands, delivering creative campaigns and digital projects across websites, social media, video and other marketing channels. With the freedom to take ownership of your accounts and the support of experienced creative and digital teams, you'll see your projects through from the first conversation to the finished result.
What's in it for you
- Hybrid working, with three days in the Sunderland office and two days working from home.
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, with additional holiday or an equivalent salary increase after five years' service.
- The opportunity to deliver creative and digital campaigns for nationally and internationally recognised brands.
- Ongoing professional development, with access to online learning, training and career progression opportunities.
- Pension, life assurance and additional wellbeing benefits.
- Free parking nearby and the support of an established, collaborative creative team.

Your responsibilities as Account Manager
- Manage a portfolio of client accounts, building relationships that support retention and long-term growth.
- Oversee creative and digital projects from initial brief through to delivery, ensuring deadlines and expectations are met.
- Coordinate designers, digital specialists and external partners to deliver campaigns across multiple channels.
- Manage project budgets, estimates and timelines to maintain quality and commercial performance.
- Identify opportunities to develop existing accounts and introduce additional services.
- Work alongside senior colleagues to ensure campaigns meet client objectives and deliver measurable value.

What we're looking for in an Account Manager
- Experience managing client relationships within a creative, digital, communications or design and print agency.
- Experience delivering projects across digital channels, including websites, email, social media, video or animation.
- Strong project management skills, including managing multiple deadlines, budgets and estimates.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting ideas and coordinating stakeholders.
- Commercial awareness and experience identifying opportunities to develop existing client relationships.

Experience within healthcare or life sciences would be advantageous, particularly knowledge of Veeva, ABPI requirements or technical content development. Marketing or digital qualifications at degree or postgraduate level would also be welcomed.
Working hours: Full-time, with three days office-based and two days working from home.
Ready to take ownership of exciting client projects and build relationships that make a real difference? Apply today for this Account Manager opportunity in Sunderland.
Candidate Source Ltd is an advertising agency. Once you have submitted your application it will be passed to the third party Recruiter who is responsible for processing your application. title: Content Editor (3 months)
description:
Content Editor
- Location: Manchester, Newcastle, York, Birmingham, Cambridge, Swindon or homeworking (candidates cannot be based in Inner London)
- Salary: £17.95 per hour
- Job Type: Temporary Contract, Full Time (3 Months)

REED Marketing & Creative are pleased to be partnering with a leading heritage and public sector organisation to recruit a Content Editor on a 3-month contract. This is an exciting opportunity to support a major website content migration project, helping to review, refine and improve a large archive of digital content ahead of its move to a new platform.

The Role

This role will play a key part in the migration of a well-established blog archive onto a new website platform. You'll review existing content, assess its relevance and accuracy, and support the delivery of an improved user experience through content optimisation and reformatting.

Key Responsibilities
- Review and rationalise an archive of approximately 450 blog articles
- Assess content and determine which articles should be retained, removed or prioritised for migration
- Update retained content to ensure accuracy, relevance and alignment with current standards
- Support the migration of content from an existing blog platform to a new website environment
- Reformat and enhance migrated content to improve presentation and user experience
- Work within established content governance and editorial guidelines

Experience & Skills required
- Previous experience working with content management systems
- Strong working knowledge of WordPress
- Experience using Umbraco or a similar CMS is highly desirable
- Excellent editorial skills with strong attention to detail
- Experience reviewing, updating and maintaining digital content
- Ability to manage large volumes of content and prioritise effectively
- Strong organisational and communication skills

Interested? Apply online or contact Jo Aldred at Reed Marketing & Creative. Closing Date: Friday 13th November 2026

title: CRM Executive
description:
The Business:
This is a unique opportunity to join a private equity-backed business at a pivotal point in its journey.

With significant investment, a refreshed leadership team, and multiple transformation programmes underway, the organisation is entering its next phase of growth. They are now looking to shape the marketing team and bring on board a progressive, tech-savvy CRM candidate.

The role can suit an entry level candidate with an appetite in marketing, CRM, customer communications or digital campaigns and want a role where you can genuinely learn and progress or an slightly more experience CRM Exec with 3-4 years' experience in CRM, customer communications or lifecycle marketing, with hands-on exposure to customer journeys, segmentation and automation.

The Role:
- Supporting and developing CRM and customer communication campaigns
- Building and managing customer journeys
- Using segmentation and targeting to personalise communications
- Creating clear, engaging customer content across email, app, SMS and digital channels
- Supporting automated and trigger-based communications
- Testing, reporting and identifying opportunities to improve campaign performance
- Working with teams across CRM, Digital, Product, Operations, Customer Services, Compliance and Technology
- Ensuring communications meet the necessary governance and compliance requirements
The Person:
- A strong communicator and writer
- Comfortable working with data, audiences and customer segmentation
- Interested in CRM technology and customer journeys
- Highly organised and detail-focused
- Comfortable working with multiple stakeholders
- Proactive, curious and willing to suggest improvements
- Able to balance engaging marketing communications with accuracy, process and compliance

If you're more experienced, ideally you'll bring around 3-4 years' experience within CRM, lifecycle marketing or customer communications, with exposure to segmentation, customer journeys, automation and CRM technology such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce or a similar platform.

title: Digital PR Consultant
company: BMC Recruitment Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Description: Digital PR Consultant
Location: North East England (Hybrid) Salary: Up to £40,000 Agency Environment
A well-established and growing integrated marketing agency in the North East is looking to appoint a Digital PR Consultant to join its expanding team. Due to continued client growth and increasing demand for Digital PR services, this is an opportunity to take ownership of campaigns, build strong client relationships, and deliver impactful results across a diverse client portfolio.
This position would suit an ambitious Digital PR professional who enjoys hands-on campaign delivery, media relations, content ideation, and securing high-quality coverage.
The Role
As a Digital PR Consultant, you'll be responsible for planning and delivering Digital PR campaigns that generate meaningful media coverage, backlinks, brand awareness, and commercial results for clients.
Working closely with clients and internal specialists, you'll develop creative campaign ideas, build relationships with journalists, and drive coverage across national, regional, trade, and online publications.
Key Responsibilities
- Deliver Digital PR campaigns from concept through to execution.
- Develop creative story angles and outreach strategies.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, influencers, and key media contacts.
- Secure high-quality media coverage and backlinks across relevant publications.
- Create press releases, media pitches, and supporting campaign content.
- Manage day-to-day client communication and reporting.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide insight-driven recommendations.
- Collaborate with SEO, Content, Social, and Marketing teams to maximise campaign impact.
- Identify reactive PR opportunities and newsjacking opportunities.
- Support the development of new campaign ideas and ongoing client growth.

About You
We're keen to speak with candidates who have:
- Previous experience within Digital PR, PR, Content Marketing, or a related agency environment.
- A proven track record of securing media coverage and building journalist relationships.
- Strong written communication and storytelling abilities.
- Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Commercial awareness and confidence working directly with clients.
- A proactive, creative approach to campaign generation.
- Knowledge of SEO and link-building principles would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer
- Salary up to £40,000 depending on experience.
- Hybrid working model.
- Genuine opportunities for progression and development.
- A collaborative and supportive agency culture.
- The chance to work with a wide range of well-known brands and exciting clients.
- A business that continues to invest heavily in its Digital PR offering and future growth plans.

title: External Affairs Manager
description:
This is a hands-on External Affairs role focused on building relationships with political, community and business stakeholders to support major development projects. Working closely with senior regional leaders, you'll help shape stakeholder engagement strategies, manage reputational issues and deliver communications activity across a large and varied region.

Client Details

Our client is a leading organisation operating across multiple regional businesses, delivering large-scale development projects that support communities, jobs and economic growth. They are seeking an External Affairs Manager to join a growing team and play a key role in managing stakeholder relationships, enhancing reputation and supporting strategic business objectives.

Description
- Build and maintain relationships with MPs, councillors, local authority officers, mayors and community stakeholders.
- Support stakeholder engagement activity linked to major development and investment projects.
- Advise senior leaders on political, reputational and communications matters.
- Manage media enquiries and identify opportunities for positive external communications.
- Organise stakeholder events, site visits and engagement programmes across the region.

Profile
- Experience in external affairs, public affairs, stakeholder engagement, communications or corporate affairs.
- Strong track record of building relationships with political or community stakeholders.
- Confident representing an organisation externally and engaging with senior decision-makers.
- Comfortable handling media enquiries and working with journalists.
- Proactive and organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Job Offer
- Permanent External Affairs Manager position.
- Salary of £45,000, could flex up for the right candidate
- Car allowance and Bonus

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
- Salary: £31,000 - £35,000
- Location: Hybrid working available after probation; office-based initially

We are recruiting on behalf of a growing business for a Marketing Executive to join their team. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded and tech-savvy professional who can increase brand visibility, drive digital engagement, and build awareness across multiple channels.

title: PPC Manager
description:
PPC Manager,Newcastle upon Tyne

Are you an experienced PPC professional looking for the opportunity to take ownership of large-scale paid search campaigns within a sizeable in-house marketing team?

Jackson Hogg is delighted to be partnering with one of the UK's leading automotive retail businesses to recruit a PPC Manager. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established marketing function where all PPC activity is managed in-house, giving you direct influence over strategy, campaign performance and commercial results.

The Role

You'll be responsible for developing, managing and optimising PPC campaigns across Google Ads, Bing Ads and Search Ads 360 (SA360), ensuring maximum return on investment and lead generation performance.

Working closely with the wider marketing team, you'll analyse campaign data, identify optimisation opportunities and drive continuous improvements across multiple accounts and budgets.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and optimise PPC campaigns across Google Ads, Bing Ads and SA360
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting and ad copy development
- Monitor campaign performance, reporting on CTR, conversion rates and ROI
- Manage significant advertising budgets and maximise spend efficiency
- Deliver A/B testing across ads and landing pages
- Produce insightful performance reporting and recommendations
- Collaborate with SEO and wider marketing teams to improve overall search performance
- Identify opportunities to increase online visibility and lead generation

About You
- 3-5 years' PPC experience
- Strong Search Ads 360 (SA360) experience is essential
- Experience managing large PPC budgets and high-volume campaigns
- Strong understanding of Google Ads, Bing Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager and Google Merchant Centre
- Advanced Excel skills and experience using reporting tools such as Looker Studio
- Highly analytical, commercially minded and data driven
- Automotive, retail or e-commerce experience would be advantageous

The Opportunity

This role offers the chance to join a growing business with a large in-house marketing team, ongoing development opportunities and genuine career progression. You'll have the autonomy to shape campaigns, influence strategy and make a measurable impact on business performance.

title: Sales, Finance & Marketing Administrator
description:
Permanent Part-time or full-time Monday to Friday

Salary; £30,000 £35,000 per annum pro rata

We are looking for an experienced and highly organised Sales, Finance & Marketing Administrator to join our team at Executive Compass.

This is a permanent, office-based role at Hoults Yard in Newcastle, with flexible hours across five days.

Applications are welcome from candidates seeking either part-time or full-time employment.

Hours and Salary
- Part-time: hours per week, Monday to Friday
- Full-time: Up to 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday
- Salary: £30,000 £35,000 full-time equivalent, pro rata to hours worked
- Example part-time patterns: 10am 2pm Monday to Friday, or 9am 3pm Monday to Friday
- Flexible start and finish times may be available within agreed working parameters

This role would suit an experienced administrator seeking a professional, predictable weekday role, whether part-time or full-time.

About the role

Executive Compass is an independent bid writing consultancy supporting organisations across the UK to win public and private-sector contracts.

You will join our sales, finance and marketing team and help keep our day-to-day commercial administration accurate, organised and running smoothly.

Your main responsibilities will include:
- Maintaining client, enquiry and opportunity records in Salesforce
- Setting up new clients and projects
- Carrying out company credit checks using Creditsafe
- Issuing terms and conditions through Signable
- Raising and issuing invoices through Xero
- Maintaining accurate spreadsheets and business records
- Monitoring outstanding invoices and supporting credit control
- Liaising professionally with clients by telephone and email
- Providing wider sales, marketing and administrative support.

As the role develops, there may also be opportunities to support outbound marketing, website administration and other commercial activities.

About you

You do not need previous experience of bid writing or tenders.

However, this is not a trainee administration role. We are looking for someone who already has experience working in an office, administration, finance support, sales support or similar business environment.

You should be:
- Highly organised
- Accurate and detail-focused
- Confident using IT and learning new systems
- Comfortable working with spreadsheets and business data
- Confident communicating with customers by telephone and email
- Able to manage your own workload
- Proactive and dependable
- Comfortable working in a busy professional office.

Experience of Salesforce, Xero or similar CRM/accounting systems would be helpful but is not essential.

Benefits

You will join a friendly and supportive Newcastle-based team and receive:

25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, pro rata

Annual leave increasing to 30 days following the qualifying period

An additional birthday holiday following probation

Annual salary reviews

Opportunities for paid overtime

Fully funded training and development

Opportunities to broaden the role as the business develops

Regular staff social events

A modern office environment at Hoults Yard.

Location

This role is office based at Hoults Yard, Newcastle upon Tyne.

Applicants must be able to travel reliably to Hoults Yard Monday to Friday.

description:

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

- Social Media Marketing

title: Communications Executive
description:
Communications Executive -
Vacancy Type: Permanent/Full Time
Location: Stockton on Tees
Wolviston Management Services are recruiting on behalf of Tioxide Materials Ltd for a Communications Executive to join their Communications team at their head office in Stockton on Tees, please see details below;

Job Purpose:
Tioxide is looking for a Communications Executive to join its Business Services team and support communications activity across Tioxide and the wider LB Group.
Reporting to the Strategic Communications Manager, this is a varied role providing the opportunity to work across internal and external communications, digital channels, content development, marketing communications, brand management and business events.

The Communications Executive will develop engaging, high-quality content, help manage Tioxide's digital communication channels and support the delivery of communications projects and campaigns that strengthen the Tioxide brand and support wider business objectives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a communications professional looking to develop their career within an international manufacturing organisation, combining hands-on content creation with corporate, digital and strategic communications exposure.

Roles and Responsibilities:
- Content Development Develop and maintain high-quality communications materials including marketing literature, presentations, website content, social media content and internal communications, ensuring messaging is engaging, accurate and aligned with business and brand objectives.
- Digital Communications Support the management and development of Tioxide's digital communications channels, including websites, intranet, social media, webinars and email communications. Ensure content remains current, engaging and consistent with corporate brand standards.
- Marketing Communications Support Assist with the planning and delivery of integrated marketing communications activities, campaigns and customer-facing communications across the business.
- Communications Coordination Support the effective management of communications projects, schedules and workflows, working with colleagues and stakeholders to ensure activities are delivered to a high standard and within agreed timescales.
- Brand Governance Act as a Tioxide brand ambassador, helping ensure communications materials consistently reflect corporate branding, key messages and visual identity guidelines.
- Crisis and Issues Communications Provide communications support during business issues, incidents and crisis situations, assisting with the preparation and timely distribution of appropriate communications materials.
- Communications Centre of Excellence Support the delivery of Communications Centre of Excellence activities, providing content, digital and wider communications support for Tioxide and LB Group initiatives.
- Measurement and Reporting Maintain communications metrics, reporting tools and dashboards, monitoring the performance and effectiveness of communications activity and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

Experience and Qualifications:
Essential
- Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
- Minimum of two years' experience within communications, marketing, public relations or a related role.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Excellent copywriting, editing and proofreading capability.
- Experience managing or supporting digital communications including websites, social media platforms and content management systems.
- Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities and competing deadlines.
- Confident working with stakeholders across different functions and levels of an organisation.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and SharePoint.
- Experience using communications and content tools such as Canva, WordPress, Hootsuite or similar platforms.

Desirable
- Experience working within a manufacturing, chemical, engineering, energy or other industrial environment.
- Experience supporting both internal and external corporate communications.
- Experience of communications within a multi-site or international organisation.
- Exposure to crisis, incident or issues communications.
- Experience using communications analytics, performance metrics and reporting dashboards.
- Experience supporting corporate brand standards and brand governance.
- Experience coordinating events, webinars or other stakeholder communications activity.

Benefits
We offer a Workplace Pension Scheme via Legal & General, there is a 4% minimum employee contribution, the company will match your own contributions up to a maximum of 8%. We also allow employee Additional Voluntary Contributions to help you save for the future. Private Medical Insurance (optional), Life Assurance and Income Protection are all included as contractual benefits with us, providing desired security where it matters most.

About the Organisation
Tioxide manufactures premium-performance titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigments, marketed under the TIOXIDE and DELTIO brands, and supplied to customers worldwide across a range of essential applications.

Headquartered in Stockton-on-Tees in the UK, Tioxide combines more than 50 years of manufacturing heritage with advanced technical expertise, strong customer partnerships, and a commitment to continuous innovation.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of LB Group, the world's leading TiO2 pigment and titanium sponge manufacturer, Tioxide is entering an exciting new chapter. As the business continues to evolve, we are welcoming new talent to help build on our strong heritage and contribute to our future success.

At Tioxide, you'll have the chance to make a real impact in a business where people work together, take ownership, deliver on their commitments and continually look for better ways of doing things.
Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, you'll be joining a business with a proud history, a supportive team and a clear vision for the future.
